exposure: location of force application (fingertip, palmar, dorsal)
outcome: amount of force during simulated disimpaction
themes derived from free-text answers to questionnaires
cohort: The study included 13 obstetricians of varying seniority participating in a national course on rotational vaginal birth and complex caesarean birth.
finding: A sensorised glove was found to have potential for training in the management of impacted fetal head, with consistent use of fingertips to deliver force and variability in dorsal and palmar regions revealing differences in hand positioning and technique.
